description: Synthetic prompts for the routing-mode probe (scripts/probe-modes.mjs): each with the tier and activity a reader would expect, across the tier x activity cells a prompt can realistically reach. No real user text.

probes.text: Run git status.
Fix the typo 'recieve' in README.md.
What is the default port in config.yaml?
Rename the variable cnt to count in utils.py line 12.
Add a --verbose flag to the CLI that prints each file it processes.
The unit test test_parse_date fails with 'invalid month 13'. Find out why and fix it.
Review this 20-line diff to the logger for obvious mistakes.
Write a short README section that explains how to run the tests.
Restart the docker compose stack and check that all containers are healthy.
Where in this repo is the HTTP retry logic implemented?
Implement cursor pagination for the /orders API endpoint, with tests.
Requests time out now and then under load in staging. Investigate the connection pool and fix the cause.
Plan the migration of our settings from YAML files to a SQLite table, step by step.
Review the pull request that refactors the payment module for correctness and missed edge cases.
Write a GitHub Actions workflow that builds, tests and publishes the Docker image on tags.
Explain how the login flow works across the gateway, the auth service and the frontend.
Design and implement a lock-free concurrent hash map in Rust with resizing and a full test suite.
A rare data race corrupts the ledger about once a week in production. Find the root cause across the three services and fix it.
Design how to split our monolith into services: data ownership, migration order and a rollback plan.
Do a security review of our OAuth implementation, token storage and session handling.
